issues.title: Broken Internal Cross-References (Slot Collisions)
issues.why: The module uses identical numeric prefixes (01, 02, 04, 05, 06, 07) for both root files and subfolders. A mediocre AI will resolve '[01-ci-pipeline.md](./01-ci-pipeline.md)' to the root file but may fail to distinguish it from the subfolder '01-browser-extension-deploy/01-ci-pipeline.md' when referenced via shorthand or relative paths in complex logic.
issues.fix: Enforce explicit path resolution in all links and rename colliding root files to include a '-generic' suffix.

issues.title: Missing GWT/Verifies for Technical Interface
issues.why: While the overview has ACs, the '11-technical-interface.md' (referenced in inventory but content truncated/missing in provided text) lacks specific GWT criteria for the secrets schema and environment variable contracts.
issues.fix: Add a dedicated 97-acceptance-criteria.md section for the Technical Interface with GWT blocks for secret validation.

issues.title: Unresolved External Linter Dependencies
issues.why: AC-05 and AC-07 reference 'check-tree-health.cjs' and 'check-spec-cross-links.py' which are not provided in the context, leaving the AI unable to verify the 'tree-health gate' logic.
issues.fix: Provide the interface/CLI contract for the referenced linter scripts in a shared-conventions file.
